$comment: What this extension builds from. A bump is a PR; docs/PACKAGING.md says how. opentide.version is the opentide CI tests the extension against (the extension bundles none: it runs the user's own). The highlights zip and the engine come from the same language-server release.

opentide.$comment: The opentide CI's real-opentide and integration tests install (pip install opentide==<version>).

engine.$comment: The opentide language server built for WebAssembly (wasm-bindgen --target web): the lowest runtime tier, editor features with nothing installed, and the engine of the web extension. From the same language-server release as the highlights zip.
